company_name: AccoTEST BU. of Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Co.,Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — AccoTEST specializes in analog/mixed signal test systems, which are critical for validating the performance of semiconductor devices.
summary: AccoTEST, a business unit of Beijing Huafeng Test & Control Technology Co., Ltd., provides cost-effective analog and mixed signal test systems for various semiconductor applications. Their solutions are designed to support the testing needs of discrete components, SOCs, and power electronics, including SiC and GaN technologies.

regional_presence.China: AccoTEST operates from offices in China, providing comprehensive support to local and international customers.
regional_presence.Japan: The company has a presence in Japan to cater to regional semiconductor testing needs.
regional_presence.Malaysia: AccoTEST maintains operations in Malaysia to support its customer base in Southeast Asia.
regional_presence.South Korea: Representatives in South Korea help facilitate customer engagement and support.
regional_presence.United States: The company has representatives in the United States to address the North American market.
